summary: Jan–Mar 2026 yield 2.98 t/ha (363 t), 19.2% above Q1 2025, but 2026 manuring and weeding had not started by March (Agro).
Jan–Dec 2025 FFB was 1,627.55 t or 13.34 t/ha per the Agronomy report, well below the 22.40 t/ha budget; the PA report's 14.76 t/ha appears to be the 2024 figure.
Harvester shortage drove low crop recovery: only 13 (P02) and 17 (P03) rounds in 2025 against 24, intervals up to 26 days and over 10% overripe bunches.
P90 (36.99 ha, 1990) is effectively unproductive at 0.35 t/ha pending a solar project decision; replanting deferred.
Ganoderma present in P02/P03 with no census or deboling yet, despite repeated instructions.

issues.title: 2025 yield in PA report appears to be last year's figure
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 section 6 reports 2025 production 1,799.89 t at 14.76 t/ha (and 2024 as 1,871.07 t at 15.34 t/ha). Agro 1/2026 Appendix 2 and 3 show 1,799.89 t / 14.76 t/ha is 2024 and 1,871.07 t / 15.34 t/ha is 2023; 2025 was 1,627.55 t / 13.34 t/ha (monthly figures add up, and Agro Table 10 block yields give the same tonnage). The PA block yields (P90 6.79 to 1.32, P02 22.39 to 20.56, P03 18.48 to 20.61) are likewise 2023 vs 2024. On the Agro figure, 2025 is 40% below the 22.40 t/ha budget, not 34% as PA states, and 9.6% below 2024, not 4%.

issues.title: Agronomy Table 10 estate totals use simple averages
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 10 gives estate yield 14.16 t/ha (2024) and 11.77 t/ha (2025); these are unweighted averages of the three block yields. Hectare-weighted totals are 14.76 and 13.34 t/ha, matching Appendix 3. The -9.6% change shown is the weighted figure, so the table is internally inconsistent.

issues.title: Block yield-change percentages wrong in Agronomy Table 10
issues.detail: P02 shown as -5.4% (20.56 to 15.33 t/ha) but actual change is -25.4%; P90 shown as -71.5% (1.32 to 0.35) but actual is -73.5%.

issues.title: PA labour table does not agree with its own text
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table shows harvesters required 9, actual 4, and total required 14 vs actual 8 with difference -4 (arithmetic gives -6). Text para 3.1 says harvesters required were 4 (1:20 ha, excluding P90), only 2 available in December, and para 3.2 says 4 available by May 2026 and adequate. The Field Worker line also shows difference 0 although 0 actual vs 2 required is -2.

issues.title: Harvester shortfall differs between reports
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 (visit 13 Apr 2026) says the estate was short of three harvesters; PA 1/2026 (visit 13 May 2026) says 2 new harvesters were recruited and 4 was adequate. Both may be true at their dates but use different requirement bases (PA excludes P90).

issues.title: Palm census SPH arithmetic error
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 3 shows P2002 with 1,596 palms on 12.58 ha at 133 SPH; 1,596 / 12.58 = 127 SPH. P2003 (9,504 / 72.40 = 131.3) is shown as 132. Census has not been updated.

issues.title: 2025 manuring dates differ
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 manuring table shows round 1 scheduled Feb, applied March, and round 2 scheduled May, applied June. Agro 1/2026 Table 4 shows round 1 (program Feb-25) completed Jan 2025 and round 2 completed May 2025.

issues.title: Agronomy Appendix 2 yield statistics inconsistent
issues.detail: Appendix 2 gives 2022 as 1,239.48 t (10.16 t/ha) while Appendix 3 gives 1,411.65 t (11.57 t/ha). For 2024 it shows P1990 at 1.39 t/ha (48.79 / 36.99 = 1.32) and P2003 at 20.38 t/ha (1,492.42 / 72.40 = 20.61). Its final column is headed 2025 as at March and stops before full-year 2025.

issues.title: Blocking table acreage arithmetic
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 1: P02/C 91.4 ac less 60.3 ac converted to solar leaves 31.1 ac (matches 12.58 ha), but the table shows 30.25 ac; the 300.55 ac total carries the error.

actions.item: Start 2026 manuring (revised programme) without further delay
Ganoderma census and deboling (1.5 x 1.5 x 1.5 m) in P02 and P03
Update palm census for P02 and P03 (combine with Ganoderma census)
Cut harvesting interval and fill harvester gap to stop overripe crop losses
Resume harvesting in P90 to recover available crop
Decide future of P90 (solar project vs replanting)
Raise harvester productivity by working 9 hours a day (now about 6)
Improve sprayers' productivity; selective spraying could reach 6 ha/man-day
Prepare daily costing book for spraying
Spray remaining VOPs and regenerating Tetracera in next selective round
Review manuring piece rate (RM2.50/bag gives RM62.50/day, below RM65.38 basic)
Continue quarterly rat census; no baiting needed yet

kb:
LADANG CHEMBONG (Jubilant Rewards Sdn Bhd, Prosper group). Estate Manager Mr Robin A/L Sinnappanah; Senior Manager En. Zulkarnain Bin Barik; Plantation Controller Dr Chua Chin Kok; Junior Assistant Manager Vivekgan A/L Gopal (joined estate 10/04/2025). Planting Advisor Mr Boey Chee Weng. Agronomists Muhammad Ghazali Abdul Ghani (Junior) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior).

SOURCES. (1) PA 1/2026 = Planting Advisory Report 01/2026, visit 13 May 2026, review period January to December 2025. It has no cost sections (no general charges, upkeep cost, harvesting cost or cost of production tables). (2) Agro 1/2026 = Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 13 April 2026 (previous agronomy visit 24 October 2025), data to March 2026.

AREA (PA 1/2026). Total estate 209.2 ha: mature oil palm 121.97 ha (P1990 36.99 ha, P2002 12.58 ha, P2003 72.4 ha); new solar project 69.14 ha; housing complex, vacant areas and roads 11.82 ha; Kementerian Belia dan Sukan (KBS) 6.27 ha. No immature or replant area. No change in area. P90 status undecided; company reportedly planning a solar project; blanket spraying done on P90 as recommended by the agronomist; one harvester deployed to harvest where possible; no pruning for a long time.
AREA (Agro 1/2026). Blocking unchanged. About 69% of planted area is palms aged 20 to 25 years, 31% over-aged palms over 26 years. Final replanting decision for P90 not made; portions earmarked for solar panels; initial meeting and site visit for the solar project end January 2026. Acreage table: original 506.07 ac; 189.2 ac converted to solar (2015 12.1, 2016 5.9, 2017 171.2); 15.5 ac taken by KBS; remaining P90/B 91.40 ac (SPA 48), P02/C 30.25 ac (SPA 55), P03/D 178.90 ac (SPA 55). Palm census (unchanged, not updated): P1990 4,366 palms, 118 SPH; P2002 1,596 palms, 133 SPH (arithmetic gives 127); P2003 9,504 palms, 132 SPH. Estate advised to update census and combine with Ganoderma census.

LABOUR (PA 1/2026). Table: harvesters/pruners required 9, actual 4 (-5); loaders/drivers 1/1; field workers weeding/manuring required 2, actual 0; estate checkroll workers required 1, actual 2; security guard 1/1; total required 14, actual 8, difference shown -4 (arithmetic -6). Text: harvesters required 4 at 1:20 ha excluding P90; only 2 available as of December 2025 (1:42 ha), short of 2. As of May 2026, 2 new harvesters recruited, 4 available and adequate. Weeding and manuring assisted by workers from Batu Sablas Estate. Worker ratio 1:15 ha, satisfactory. GMD earlier said permanent harvesters should be kept at 6 and an additional harvester must be recruited immediately. Staff: Manager plus Jr Assistant Manager, no change, adequate.
LABOUR (Agro 1/2026). Estate short of three harvesters at April visit; fertiliser applicators were deployed from Perhentian Tinggi Estate in 2025 and at the visit were doing sub-soil application at Perhentian Tinggi.

WEEDING (PA 1/2026, 2025). Circle spraying 243.94 ha (2 rounds) = 100% of budget; circles clean; Inter Pump output 4.5 ha/man-day; piece rate RM20/ha; earnings RM90/man-day. Selective spraying 243.94 ha (2 rounds) = 100%; inter-rows clean; Tetracera regenerating; remaining VOPs to eradicate; mist blower output 4 ha/man-day, potential 6; piece rate RM20/ha; earnings RM80/man-day. No daily costing book yet.
WEEDING (Agro 1/2026). 2025 weeding completed as planned. As of March 2026 no inter-row or circle weeding done; inter-row weeding seen in progress in P02 at visit. Vegetation acceptable, soft grasses, minimal competition.

MANURING (PA 1/2026, 2025). 84.98 ha of 84.98 ha budgeted applied (P02 and P03; P90 not manured). Schedule: rounds Feb, May, Aug, Nov; actual March, June, Aug, Nov. Wheelbarrow application 25 bags/man-day; piece rate RM2.50/bag; earnings RM62.50/man-day, below basic wage RM65.38/day; suggested to raise the rate in line with new RM1,700/month salary scale.
MANURING (Agro 1/2026). 2025: NK1 at 2.00 kg/palm (2,000 g) broadcast, four rounds on P02 and P03, recorded completed Jan, May, Aug and Nov 2025, no delays. Original 2026 programme: Mixture A 2.25 kg (2,250 g) Feb and Aug, NK1 2.00 kg (2,000 g) May and Nov. Not started as of March 2026 due to uncertainty over the solar project. Revised 2026 programme (Appendix 1, kg/palm): P90 nil; P02 and P03 MIX A 2.00 kg (2,000 g), NK1 1.75 kg (1,750 g), MIX A 2.00 kg (2,000 g). NK1 = 50% AS : 50% MOP. Mixture A = 45% SOA : 0% RP : 40% MOP : 15% kieserite.

PEST AND DISEASE. PA: no rat or bagworm issues; Ganoderma sporadic in P02 and P03; deboling not done yet. Agro: rat damage census 2025 below 20% platform basis (P2002 5.62%, 5.27%, 5.33%, 5.12% by quarter; P2003 7.83%, 7.41%, 7.16%, 7.36%); Q1 2026 P2002 5.31%, P2003 6.90%; no baiting needed, keep monitoring. No leaf-eating pests. Ganoderma symptoms in old plantings, no census or treatment carried out; advised detailed census and deboling of severely affected or dead palms in P02 and P03, pits 1.5 m x 1.5 m x 1.5 m.

ROADS AND DRAINS (PA). 300 chains budgeted for grading, none done (manager says grading without compaction not effective, volume too small for contractor). Roads satisfactory with minor damage. No drain issues, no drain budget.

PRUNING. PA: 84.98 ha of 84.98 ha progressively pruned to December 2025 (P02 12.58, P03 72.4), satisfactory; cost RM1.20/palm/year. Agro: pruning acceptable in P02 and P03; P90 under-pruned.

CROP (PA 1/2026, as reported). Table labelled 2024 vs 2025: P1990 6.79 to 1.32 t/ha (-80%); P2002 22.39 to 20.56 (-8%); P2003 18.48 to 20.61 (+11.5%); estate 15.34 to 14.76 (-4%); production 1,871.07 t to 1,799.89 t. Says 14.76 t/ha is 34% below budget 22.40 t/ha. Harvesting rounds 15 against budget 24. Interval averaged 17 days. Outturn 95%. Evacuation: 1 Badang (2 cutters, 1 collector) and 1 mini dumper (1 cutter, 1 collector). Bunch weights Dec 2024 vs Dec 2025: 2002 21.5 to 21.3 kg; 2003 21.1 to 21.6 kg. Harvesting rate RM48/t; output 1.95 t/man-day (2002) and 1.87 (2003); earnings RM93.60 and RM89.76 vs basic RM65.38. Manual loading tractor grabber 5.82 t/day at RM7.00, earning RM40.74. Harvesters work about 6 hours a day; should work 9. Low cropping season, many male flowers.
CROP (Agro 1/2026). Monthly production 2025 totals 1,627.55 t = 13.34 t/ha; 2024 1,799.89 t = 14.76 t/ha; 2023 1,871.07 t = 15.34 t/ha; 2022 1,411.65 t = 11.57; 2021 1,644.91 t = 13.49; 2020 2,638.65 t = 21.63 (Appendix 2). Block yields 2024 vs 2025: P90 1.32 to 0.35; P02 20.56 to 15.33; P03 20.61 to 19.63; decline 9.6%. 2025 harvesting rounds: P90 0.5 (2%), P02 13 (54%), P03 17 (71%). Q1 2026: 363.00 t, 2.98 t/ha vs 2.50 t/ha Q1 2025 (+19.2%); P90 0.0, P02 3.95 (+48.5%), P03 4.33 (+21.6%); rounds 5.5 of 6 for P02 and P03, P90 zero. 2026 monthly: Jan 169.82, Feb 80.85, Mar 112.33 t. Harvesting intervals Oct 2025 to Mar 2026 ranged up to 26 days (P02 Oct-25 11-26; P03 Oct-25 19-25, Nov/Dec/Jan up to 25), exceeding 15 days; over 10% overripe bunches on P03 platforms; loose fruit collection acceptable.
NOTE ON CONFLICT: the PA 2025 figures (1,799.89 t, 14.76 t/ha) equal the Agronomy report's 2024 figures; the Agronomy monthly data show 2025 = 1,627.55 t, 13.34 t/ha. The dashboard uses the Agronomy figure.

RAINFALL (both reports agree). 2025: 2,436 mm, 124 days (low Jan 80, Jun 84, Jul 49 mm; high Apr 451, Nov 448 mm). 2024 2,481 mm/148 days; 2023 2,451/140; 2022 3,123/169; 2021 2,570/137. Jan to Mar 2026: 332 mm, 16 days. Agro says the June to July 2025 drought likely hurt palms; heavy April and November rain disrupted work.

CONCLUSIONS. PA: few issues; circles and inter-rows satisfactory; focus on sprayer and harvester productivity; retain harvesters through higher earnings. Agro: 2025 yield declined; early 2026 improved; crop recovery must improve; 2026 programme revised.

PERIODS. Estate yields: Jan-Dec 2025 = 13.34 t/ha (1,627.55 t); Jan-Dec 2024 = 14.76 t/ha; Jan-Mar 2026 = 2.98 t/ha (363.00 t) vs Jan-Mar 2025 = 2.50 t/ha (304.40 t). Block yields on the dashboard are Jan-Dec 2025 vs Jan-Dec 2024 (Agro Table 10). Budget yield 22.40 t/ha is for Jan-Dec 2025 (PA 6.1). Note Jul and Aug 2025 monthly production are both shown as 146.74 t in Agro Appendix 3 (total still sums to 1,627.55 t).

ffbProd.notes: PA Report 1/2026 section 6 table is labelled 2024 vs 2025 but prints 1,871.07 t (2024) and 1,799.89 t (2025); these are actually the 2023 and 2024 actuals per Agronomy Appendix 2/3 - PA labels are one year out, so PA 'Jan-Dec 2025 = 1,799.89 t / 14.76 t/ha' conflicts with Agronomy 2025 = 1,627.55 t / 13.34 t/ha. Used Agronomy (monthly table). 2022 conflict inside Agronomy 1/2026: Appendix 2 prints 2022 total 1,239.48 t (10.16 t/ha, fields 49.92+153.75+1,035.81) but Appendix 3 monthly sums to 1,411.65 t (11.57 t/ha); used 1,411.65 (monthly, sums verified). Appendix 2 column headed '2025 as at March' (304.40 t) equals Jan-Mar 2025 from Appendix 3 (95.04+97.12+112.24). July and August 2025 are both printed as 146.74 in Appendix 3 (possible duplicate entry) but the year total still sums to 1,627.55. Jan-Mar 2026 monthly sums to 363.00, agreeing with cumulative. PA 1/2026 (visit 13 May 2026) has no 2026 tonnage.

manuring.v: 84.98 ha out of 84.98 ha budgeted applied (P02 + P03; P90 excluded). Wheelbarrows, 25 bags/man-day, RM2.50/bag = RM62.50/man-day, below the daily basic wage of RM65.38; PA suggests raising the piece rate for the new RM1,700/month scale. Manuring and weeding done by workers from Batu Sablas / Perhentian Tinggi.

spraying.v: 243.94 ha (2 rounds) = 100% of budget (122 ha mature x 2). Inter Pump 4.5 ha/man-day, RM20/ha, RM90/man-day (satisfactory). No daily costing book yet.
243.94 ha (2 rounds) = 100% of budget. Mist blower 4 ha/man-day (potential 6 ha), RM20/ha, RM80/man-day.

pests.v: Pests under control; no rat or bagworm issue; Ganoderma sporadic in P02 and P03.

other.v: Agro 1/2026 monthly table: 2025 total 1,627.55 t = 13.34 t/ha vs 2024 1,799.89 t = 14.76 t/ha (-9.6% on tonnes/ha). PA 1/2026 prints 14.76 t/ha (1,799.89 t) as 2025 and 15.34 t/ha (1,871.07 t) as 2024 - those are the 2024 and 2023 figures, so the PA yield table looks one year stale. PA: budget 22.40 t/ha; 15 rounds vs 24 budgeted; average interval 17 days; outturn 95%.

Total 209.20 ha: mature 121.97 ha (P90 36.99, P02 12.58, P03 72.40); new solar project 69.14 ha; housing, vacant, roads 11.82 ha; KBS (Kementerian Belia dan Sukan) 6.27 ha. Blocking table in acres lists 506.07 ac with 189.2 ac converted to solar, 15.5 ac taken by KBS (column layout garbled).

Harvesters/pruner required 9, actual 4 (-5) (4 required at 1:20 ha excluding P90; 2 in Dec 2025, 1:42 ha); 2 new harvesters recruited by May 2026, now 4 and adequate. Total 8 workers vs 14 required. Group MD: keep 6 permanent harvesters; recruit an extra harvester. Harvesters work only about 6 hours/day (aim 9).
1 Badang with 2 cutters + 1 collector, and 1 mini dumper with 1 cutter + 1 collector. Manual loading tractor grabber Div A 5.82 t/day at RM7.00/t = RM40.74/day.

300 chains budgeted for grading, none done: not effective without compaction and volume too low to mobilise a motor grader. Roads surfaced with laterite and crusher run, satisfactory with minor damage. No drain budget, no drain issues.

2025: 2,436 mm on 124 rain days (low in Jan 80 mm, Jun 84 mm, Jul 49 mm; over 250 mm in Apr 451 mm and Nov 448 mm). Jan-Mar 2026: Jan 17.0 mm (3 days), Feb 208.0 mm (6), Mar 107.0 mm (7) = 332.0 mm on 16 days. Drought in Jun-Jul 2025 expected to have hurt palm growth.

blockGaps: No costs in PA 1/2026 for Chembong. No block-level cost, no soil analysis, no Ganoderma census (none done). Leaf analysis sampling date not stated (Agro 2/2025). Months of the revised 2026 programme read from the 12-column layout and not confirmed in the PDF. Agro Appendix 2 (yield statistic) in Agro 1/2026 repeats the Agro 1/2025 figures, and Table 10 prints an estate total of 11.77 t/ha that does not match the 13.34 t/ha implied by the monthly production table. PA 1/2026 yield table appears to repeat 2023/2024 data under 2024/2025 headings. The pruning/inter-row/circle quality tick tables and solar area acreage columns could not be read. Pests/diseases for P90 are not described in either report.
blockMap: Dashboard ids P90, P02, P03 are printed P1990 / P90B, P2002 / P02C and P2003 / P03D in the reports. The Agro blocking table (in acres) uses P85/A, P90/B, P02/C, P03/D: P85/A is not a dashboard block (fully converted to solar).
